title: Replay of #15: a session whose state lost its jobs gets them back from the store (issue #11)
notes: Source 1bc830e (the parent of PR #15), hidden tests from its merge faa02a8 (tests/ replaced whole). testsChanged is true: PR #15 changed tests/workers.test.tsx. The issue is the real one; both comments were posted before the PR. An Acceptance details block (plan Q12, decided on the review of PR #42) states what the reference test checks that the issue did not give: the jobs are kept in $.store, not a file, under the key jobs:<session id> as {at, jobs}, with the job fields the test sets (name, profile, cwd, dir, startedAt, status and token); a session whose $.state lost its jobs gets them back from there; a RESULT.md written meanwhile is delivered once, within 10 s of the session start, with nothing more after 30 s; message reaches a restored worker. The block says these details settle the issue's 'Possible directions', which are otherwise unchanged. The test also seeds jobs:old (at 0, no jobs), which it does not assert on; the issue does not mention it.
